# PLY0064 — value image invalid

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Message | `<reason>` |
| Severity | error |
| Exit code | 2 (UsageError) |
| Strict promotion | no |
| Rule | `verification.images` |
| Area | infrastructure |
| Owning issue | VER-IMAGES |
| Status | active |
| Seen in | loading a vector file whose signature names an unknown image type, or whose input or expected image is truncated, has bytes left over or is not canonical, as '\<file\>: signature: unknown image type 'int'' or '\<file\>: vector '\<name\>': input image has 1 byte(s) left over after '\<parameter\>''; encoding a value that does not fit its image type, as 'value 256 does not fit u8' |

## Cause

A vector file used with a language runner, or a value handed to the image codec, breaks the rules of
the value images (`Polypiler.Core.Verification/Images`): the `signature` names an unknown image
type or is not of its JSON form, `export` and `signature` do not come together, a vector carries
both `expected` and `expectedTrap`, an input or expected image is truncated, has bytes left over or
is not the canonical image of any value (a `bool` byte other than `00`/`01`, a union tag beyond its
alternatives, a `bigint` with a redundant sign byte, ill-formed UTF-8), or a value does not fit its
type. Images are compared as bytes, so a non-canonical image is refused even where it would decode.

## Example

```text
tests/fixtures/verify/images/invalid/leftover.json: vector 'five bytes': input image has 1 byte(s) left over after 'x'
value 256 does not fit u8
```

## What to do

Write every value as the image of the type its parameter or result declares: the input image is the
`in` and `inout` arguments in order, the output image the result followed by the `inout` and `out`
values after the call. Fix the width in the signature, not in the bytes; a value that does not fit
belongs to a wider type. `tests/fixtures/verify/images/conformance.json` shows one image of every type.
